messages.author: e7ac078aa107d03d
messages.subject: Example Apps Grayed out
parts:
Hi all, 

Made the mistake of updating some of my R packages, which caused issues when running shiny apps.  I reverted back to the old packages but now all of my shiny apps, as well as the examples are 'grayed out'.  I am on R 3.0.0, and Shiny 0.5.0, and Chrome.  The error is: 

WebSocket connection to 'ws://localhost:8100/' failed: Error during WebSocket handshake: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol mismatch

Any suggestions?

Thanks, 

Amanda

messages.author: cb6ccc42dea8d83c
messages.subject: Re: Example Apps Grayed out
parts:
See thread "Recent Chrome update is causing immediate drop of local host:8100 connection".
Winston suggested try upgrading to the latest version of Shiny, 0.7.0, with install.packages('shiny') - there was a fix a chrome-websocket issue.
It worked for me.
